image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ installed in a stone gallery within a church or cathedral. The instrument features multiple tiers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, encased in reddish-brown carved wood. The central section has taller pipes flanked by shorter ones, creating a symmetrical stepped silhouette. Stone arches frame the organ on both sides.
